headline: 便當遭劫！辦公室國安危機
ticker: 冰箱防線全面失守｜神祕同事嘴角有飯｜最後一塊排骨誰吞了
anchor_script: 荒謬劇場快訊！公司冰箱爆發便當劫案！苦主午休開門，只見空盒，排骨離奇蒸發！同事嘴角一粒白飯，竟成破案關鍵！主管緊急封鎖茶水間，成立滷汁專案小組！嫌疑人辯稱只是幫忙試溫，現場湯匙當場落地！目前全公司進入橘色飢餓警戒，下午會議全面改審最後一口花椰菜！

shots.scene_en: In a reenactment filmed from inside an office refrigerator, an employee carefully places a plain lunchbox on a shelf and smiles, with no text, letters, or logos visible.

In a high-angle reenactment inside the office kitchenette, a sneaky coworker crouches behind the open refrigerator door and devours a pork chop from the lunchbox, with no text, letters, or logos visible.

In a dramatic low-angle reenactment inside the kitchenette, the returning employee discovers the empty lunchbox and drops to their knees while a coworker freezes with rice stuck beside their mouth, with no text, letters, or logos visible.

In a wide-shot reenactment inside the kitchenette, a manager blocks the doorway with chairs while two employees examine a gravy stain using enormous magnifying glasses, with no text, letters, or logos visible.

In a close-up reenactment at an office conference table, the accused coworker drops a spoon as the manager solemnly presents a single broccoli floret beneath an orange warning lamp, with no text, letters, or logos visible.
